step: Read SunSpec model points (scale factor applied automatically)
note: Model.Point reads apply the SunSpec scale factor (e.g. 701.Hz, 714.DCW) transparently. Compare against the raw 701.* values in the Explorer to confirm scaling.

step: Read battery DC energy + port count (scaled)
note: 714.NPrt is the battery port (stack) count. On a MULTI-stack unit the repeating-block suffix '714.DCW_1' / '714.DCW_2' targets each port's block (library >= 0.9.x); a single-stack unit only exposes the base 714.DCW.

step: Enable remote control + set charge power (scaled write)
note: WSetPct is scale-factor converted on write (human % -> raw). Enables VPP remote control and requests ~30% charge. SPAN must be unlocked to take.
Maintain the dispatch long enough to observe it before release.

Sequencer-level release. NOTE: the library's reset_control_state() now performs a standby handshake (force 0W, settle, then WSetEna=0); this manual WSetEna=0 is the raw sequencer equivalent without the ramp-down delay.
